se932037f89f8c9: HAMi-Core: Ascend NPU user soft cut

s041cf18c2e7001: Here is a list of the audience questions and answers collected during this live broadcast:
saeaf24c38d3a0d: Q: Does the use of HAMi support the heat mounted GPU inside a container? The scene is switched from CPU to GPU, and does not need to restart Pod.

s9ceefc75947ce1: Q: Was it Ascend NPU 910B/C soft cut or was it fully open-source or commercial?
s1e6f3b41c47b0a: All are fully open. China is ascend because its Apache 2.0 protocol can be directly supported by the open source.
s712ffb5d55d787: Q: Is soft cut supporting all NPUs, 910B, 910C, 310?
s1ceaf4ac183c3b: Yes, 25.05 and above are all supported.
sb422ba1446fd66: Q: When China uses Ascend NPU (910B), the Pod resource is deleted, the vNPU block is destroyed, and PTA calls acl api fined after using 8 card integrator large model. Can restarting the server solve the problem?

s18a8412297287b: Q: Does the post-software surveillance indicator correspond to the size of the container restriction? For example, whether utilization is calculated on the basis of the size of the cut as a denominator.
s13ea50416be588: No. Current surveillance shows that the utilization factor is the physical use of the whole card, not the logical utilization factor based on the size of the cut (e.g. 20% of the physical usage divided by 30% of the quota). Similar to NVIDIA, it is the utilization factor of the whole card.
